﴿By time﴾: al-dahr (the age, or time in general), or what follows the decline of the sun after noon until sunset, or the afternoon prayer (ṣalāt al-ʿaṣr).
﴿Indeed, mankind﴾ [i.e., the species] ﴿is surely in loss﴾ [in their trade/commerce].

Tafsir al-Jalalayn (al-Mahalli and al-Suyuti) on Surah 103, verse 3:

﴿Except those who have believed and done righteous deeds﴾, so they are not in loss. ﴿And advise one another﴾, i.e., they counsel one another ﴿to truth﴾, which is faith, ﴿and advise one another to patience﴾ upon obedience and away from disobedience.
